description: Post-transaction verification using LLM-as-judge. Checks if a service delivered what was promised. Returns completeness score, accuracy score, format compliance, SLA adherence, issues list, and overall pass/fail.

expected_schema.description: Expected output format or JSON schema

request_description.description: What was requested from the service

response_data.description: The actual response/output received from the service

sla_requirements.description: SLA requirements to check against (e.g. 'response under 5s, must include all fields')

name: verify_outcome
